x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the October 2017 package was ₹2.11 lakh crore, of which ₹1.35 lakh crore came through recapitalisation bonds. Statement 3 is wrong: the 'ten into four' PSB merger was a separate consolidation that took effect from 1 April 2020, not part of the recapitalisation package. Hence 1 and 2 only.
NCLAT hears appeals from all four: NCLT orders (Sec 61 of the IBC), IBBI orders, CCI orders (from 26 May 2017) and NFRA orders (from 7 May 2018). Hence 1, 2, 3 and 4.

Punjab National Bank was founded at Lahore in 1894/95 and is now headquartered in New Delhi. Allahabad Bank dates from 1865 (Mangaluru, 1906 is Canara Bank), Canara Bank began at Mangaluru not Lahore, and Machilipatnam, 1923 is Andhra Bank, not Equitas SFB.
Capital Small Finance Bank, Jalandhar (2016), was India's first Small Finance Bank. It is not a payments bank, an RRB (the first RRB was Prathama Grameen Bank) or a DFI.

The first Presidency bank was set up in 1806 as the Bank of Calcutta (the notes also call it the Presidency Bank of Bengal) and was later renamed the Bank of Bengal. The Bank of Bombay (1840) and Bank of Madras (1843) came later.
